summary.text: William Valentine is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 2A, in Washington and Frederick counties, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired police officer, he has served in the House since January 2023 and sits on the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Valentine was born in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, graduated from Delone Catholic High School in 1989, and earned an A.A. in criminal justice from Frederick Community College in 1991.

He was a police officer in Thurmont from 1994 to 1998 and again from 2003 to 2005, a deputy sheriff in Garrett County from 1998 to 2003, and a Westminster police officer from 2005 until his retirement in 2019.
From 2019 to 2022 he was an investigator with the Frederick County State's Attorney's Office.
Valentine was elected to the House of Delegates in November 2022.
He serves on the Judiciary Committee and its Juvenile, Estates and Trusts, and Public Safety subcommittees, and was Deputy Minority Whip in 2023-2024.
